notes:
Small non-denominational church meeting in a suite on Hartman Ln in north-west Tucson (85743, near Marana). Address re-confirmed on the church's own homepage and about page on 2026-09-10: 7620 N Hartman Ln Suite #146, Tucson, AZ 85743. The site states no denominational affiliation and describes baptism by immersion; 'Independent / non-denominational' stands.

Staff confirmed from /about on 2026-09-10: Lee Giermann (Senior Pastor, since the beginning of 2018; previously 22 years as senior pastor at Lake Sawyer Christian Church, Black Diamond WA), Jonathon Basurto (Youth Pastor), David Cardarelli (Worship Minister), Sarah Bolander (Children's Ministry Director & Media Director), and elders Jerry Monroe, Bob Stoner and Vic Otero. Only Giermann is recorded as a preaching pastor - nothing on the site shows Basurto taking the Sunday pulpit, so check sermon attributions before adding him.

Sermon media: YouTube channel @horizonchurchtucson154 (channel ID UCtfcw0QW-1V5U1sYl6uZM-A) is confirmed as the church's own, but its channel description says 'Livestreams on Sunday mornings can now be found on our website, horizonchurchtucson.org.' The /sermons page on the site links back to that same channel, so the YouTube uploads may be stale - check both before fetching transcripts. Coordinates still missing; run tools/geocode.py.
